renderer: deterministic p5.js 1.11.3 Canvas 2D held-chord fold sheet
primitiveBudget: one upright folded sheet, eight generated folds, seven seams, two fixed pressure sites, internal fault arcs, and four liftable fold states
commitThreshold: both fixed pressure sites held together for at least 720ms, released, with alternating lead side
memoryRule: the pressure sites stay exact while the next fold changes position, opening, crease, notch, and seam; later chords lead from the opposite side
interactionRule: pointer or touch holds both edge sites; ArrowLeft plus ArrowRight or the chord control uses the same deterministic event; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: Canvas wash bands, pigment islands, and WebGL depth mass -> one portrait-oriented folded sheet with internal fault geometry
compositionRupture: full-field wash, loose island ecology, and central monolith -> a single upright sheet with eight staggered folds
encounterRupture: ordered route, attention click, and gate passage -> simultaneous two-site pressure held through a duration threshold
temporalRupture: transient passage followed by remote response -> duration opens a local fold and constrains the next lead
mediumRupture: raster wash, island silhouettes, and WebGL volume -> p5.js Canvas 2D fold planes, seams, and fault arcs
changedRule: A single hand is inert. A long chord between two fixed edges changes the next internal fold, and the lead side must alternate for material to accept the next event.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is one dark upright sheet of eight irregular folds. Four accepted chords change actual fold outlines, creases, openings, notches, and seams while the pressure sites remain exact.
falsifier: Delete if one-sided or short pressure commits, if the pressure sites deform, if fold change is cosmetic, if alternating lead is ignored, if later folds reset, or if lifting is inexact.
deletionCondition: Delete v049 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish the held-chord fold sheet from v046-v048 or if duration is only explanatory prose.
promotion: candidate / held pending production browser matrix, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
